notes: Fiscal year 2025 ended November 2, 2025 (52 weeks; data.js fy 'Nov 2025'). Filings: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001730168-25-000121) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001193125-26-085691), both read on www.sec.gov. HOCK TAN: President and CEO; 908,474 shares including 775,638 held by a family trust; less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. BUYBACKS are the repurchase-program line only; they exclude $3,860 million of 'Shares repurchased for tax withholdings on vesting of equity awards', a separate cash-flow line. STOCK COMP is the note total ($7,568 million, equal to the cash-flow add-back this year). GEOGRAPHY: the regional table in Note 3 is used; Broadcom notes that title for most products transfers in Penang, Malaysia, so regions reflect shipment or delivery location, not end customers. HOLDERS: both 5% figures come from older 13G/A filings (Vanguard filed October 4, 2024; BlackRock filed January 26, 2024) divided by the February 2026 share count; asOf is the filing date the proxy cites.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2025 (the same year as the head count) is used; the CEO pay ratio is 543 to 1. The median is computed the same way as the named executive officers' total compensation, so it includes the grant-date value of equity awards.
